Cream Knit & Brown Pleated Skirt
Rights check
Source: 24382.jpg
Polished, cozy, timeless
WORKING NOTES
- The pleated skirt and cream top create a clean color

- Describe the tote as 'structured leather' for a more
polished look.
Try this: Describe the tote as structured leather.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark
wavy hair and a soft smile stands on a
warm-toned street. She wears a cream
knit top with a high neck and fitted
sleeves, paired with a brown pleated
midi skirt with a wide waistband. A
pendant necklace sits at her throat, and
she carries a taupe leather tote at her
side. Warm, natural light, a palette of
cream, chocolate, and taupe. Polished
and cozy, in the style of an autumn
street-style look book.
